# Is renting out your RV worth it? Break-even nights, cash result and the rate you need

> Free profit calculator for people who rent out an RV, camper or trailer: nightly rate, nights booked, platform fee, cleaning, wear, loan, insurance, storage and depreciation become a cash result, break-even nights and the rate you need. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
